dedupe_keys.name: 土砂災害警戒区域等 landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 土砂災害警戒区域等 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 長崎県. 長崎県知事が指定する令和8年5月26日時点の土砂災害警戒区域・土砂災害特別警戒区域の範囲または位置などのデータをGISデータとして整備したものである。 ※区域境界確認には使用不可. Coverage: 長崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 長崎県. Its tags are 土木, 災害. It offers 5 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
